source_claim: AlphaEvolve contrasts code candidates with programmatic evaluation functions against AI Co-Scientist-style natural-language hypotheses and natural-language evaluation criteria
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve manifests include runtime.history.programmatic_representation_boundary_report, which labels generated candidates as executable code workspaces, proposal idea/rationale/hypothesis text as natural-language context metadata rather than candidate representation, declared evaluator metrics and deterministic evaluator validity as programmatic criteria, optional LLM feedback as post-evaluator, and hypothesis-to-code transition as required. It does not claim hallucination-risk measurement, long-horizon step-count evidence, a natural-language hypothesis-stage contract, a natural-language-to-programmatic bridge, proposal-quality truth models, or combined AI-Co-Scientist workflow evidence.
